brief:
Sindri scoping: SCP-COV-003 skips demoted and test/fixture/script files (follow-up to #1114)

Follow-up from #1114 (owner call via meta, 2026-10-25: #1114's first PR is "Part of #1114").

## Problem

`SCP-COV-003` (a depth-1 lens node that is neither mapped nor excluded) still counts files the map already marks as demoted, and files whose role is test, fixture or script. On a big repo those pad the "not covered" list with things no scope should name. #1114 narrowed the rule to anchors and their one-edge neighbours and added glob exclusions. The demoted filter is only a placeholder comment (a "seam") in the coverage check today.

## Fix

- In the scoping coverage check, skip a lens node whose file carries #1139's demoted mark (the context engine's demoted band), and skip a file whose role is test, fixture or script, using the same role source #1033 uses.
- Replace the placeholder comment with the filter.
- Tests: a demoted node and a test-role node next to an anchor don't raise SCP-COV-003; an ordinary unmapped node next to an anchor still does.

## Context

- #1114 (coverage depth), #1139 (the demoted mark on main), #1033 (file roles).
- The recipe half of #1114 (a COV-003-only `incomplete` routes to a narrow exclusions step) goes in the #1119/#1120 PR after #966.
- Owner: engine lane, after #1151.
expected: A depth-1 lens node whose file the context engine demoted (index.demote globs: tests, fixtures, scripts) or that the gather took from code.tests raises no SCP-COV-003; an ordinary unmapped node next to an anchor still does.
actual: LensBuilder.Files builds code nodes from path and label only, so the demoted filter in ScopePacketChecks.Coverage.cs NearNodes never fires and demoted/test files near an anchor each raise SCP-COV-003.
rootCause:
- NearNodes (src/Sindri/Aw.Sindri.Features/Scoping/ScopePacketChecks.Coverage.cs:214) already drops nodes with `demoted: true`, but nothing writes that field: LensBuilder.Files (src/Sindri/Aw.Sindri.Features/Scoping/LensBuilder.cs) builds each code node from path and label only, so LensFile.Demoted (src/Context/Aw.Context.Core/Lenses/LensFile.cs:44, set from ContextRepo.Demotes, ContextRepo.cs:25) is lost.
- code.tests entries are tests by construction but carry no role on the lens node, so a test next to an anchor raises SCP-COV-003.
- The packet's lenses.json schema (schemas/packets/lenses.schema.json, nodes additionalProperties false) means ScopePacket.Lenses must drop the new marks.
